name: Yokubou no Ori
source:
The lead character accidentally obtained two tools: control someone's mind, and make someone's desire visible in the shape of tentacle. By using the tools, control guys as you want, and lead the beautiful young chick into the world of sensuality! 

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE013142.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公意外得到两种工具：控制他人思想，以及让他人的欲望以触手形态显现。利用这些工具控制男人，把美丽年轻女孩引向感官世界！

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE013142.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
